title: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Leaked — 1.5M Token Context Window, 'God-Level' UI Generation
description: GPT-5.6 (codenamed 'iris-alpha') was discovered in Codex backend logs. Features a 1.5 million token context window (43% larger than GPT-5.5), commercial-grade front-end UI generation from minimal prompts. Dual-version strategy: standard + Pro (agent workflows). Expected early June 2026.

title: Google Search Overhaul Goes Live — Full AI-First Conversational Search Powered by Gemini 3.5 Flash
description: Google's biggest search change in 25 years takes effect today (May 26). The search box becomes an AI assistant powered by Gemini 3.5 Flash, generating consolidated answers instead of link lists. Experts warn this fundamentally changes SEO, digital advertising, and information trust models.

title: DeepMind's AlphaProof Nexus Solves 9 Erdős Problems and 44 Conjectures
description: Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Nexus independently solved nine open Erdős problems, 44 open conjectures, and a 15-year-old algebraic geometry problem. Despite the breakthrough, CEO Demis Hassabis stated AGI is 'still far away'. This follows OpenAI's similar Erdős-solving announcement last week.

title: Trump Cancels AI Executive Order After Musk, Zuckerberg Pressure
description: President Trump called off signing a new AI executive order hours before the ceremony. The order would have required AI companies to share advanced models with the government 90 days before release. Elon Musk, Mark Zuckerberg, and AI advisor David Sacks made last-minute calls opposing it. Trump cited concerns about 'interfering with the US lead over China.'

title: Anthropic Secures SpaceX Colossus 1 Supercomputer — 300+ MW, 220K+ GPUs
description: Anthropic reached a major compute agreement with SpaceX, gaining exclusive access to the entire 300+ MW Colossus 1 data center with over 220,000 Nvidia GPUs. Meanwhile, Claude Sonnet 4.8 ('Conway') appeared in Vertex AI backend listings, focused on persistent background agents for enterprise, targeting a June release.

title: Grok V9-Medium Completes Training — xAI Rebranded to SpaceXAI
description: Elon Musk announced Grok V9-Medium (1.5 trillion parameters) has completed training with additional Cursor data. Reinforcement learning starts in days, public release expected in 2-3 weeks. SpaceXAI (formerly xAI, acquired by SpaceX in February) is positioning Grok 5 for a June release.

title: Apple Registers genai.apple.com Ahead of WWDC 2026
description: Apple registered the genai.apple.com subdomain, signaling a major generative AI push at WWDC 2026 (June 8). Expected announcements: redesigned Siri (possibly Gemini-powered), standalone Siri app, third-party AI model extensions (Claude, Gemini, Grok), and enhanced on-device AI tools.

title: Cerebras WSE-3 Chip + OpenAI $200B Compute Order
description: Cerebras WSE-3 (5nm, 4 trillion transistors, 900K cores) achieves 5.43 PFLOPS/kW energy efficiency — nearly double Nvidia's 2.73. OpenAI placed a 750 MW compute order valued at over $200 billion. In carbon capture simulations, it's 210x faster than Nvidia H100 with sub-nanosecond latency.

title: Nvidia Q1 Revenue Surges 85% to $81.6B — Jensen Huang Visits Taiwan for TSMC 2nm
description: Nvidia beat Q1 expectations with $81.6B revenue (+85% YoY), data center sales up 92%. CEO Jensen Huang visited Taiwan ahead of Computex 2026 to secure TSMC 2nm capacity for next-gen AI chips (rumored 100K+ CUDA cores, HBM4 memory).

title: DeepSeek V4 Delayed — Shifting to Huawei Ascend Chips
description: DeepSeek's V4 model release has been delayed as the company rewrites its software stack to integrate with Huawei's Ascend chips, aligning with Beijing's push for domestic chip self-reliance. A preview version of the new open-source flagship was recently rolled out.
